description: Every model of a finite Horn theory contains its forward closure, whether or not constraints occur.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models_least.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) {X : Set α}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Γ X) (p : α) :
  p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Γ → p ∈ X
